newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline firmer, but U.S. arb now closed.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline firmer, but U.S. arb now closed.

text.p: NWE gasoline was firmer on Monday as benchmark Eurograde barges gained $2 a tonne, but the closing of the transatlantic arb kept a lid on levels, traders said.
Premium unleaded barges traded early at $212 and $213, but premiums later climbed to $215 a tonne fob ARA.

The closure of the U.S. arb depressed cargo discussion, although traders reported some uncovered demand into Poland for 95 octane material. Good prompt buying interest was also seen for 98 octane product -- in scarce supply due to poor reforming margins.
